source.description:
PROBLEM: pi-coding-agent's --list-models reports tools=yes for several models
that DON'T actually work in the agentic specialist pipeline. Documented today
(session 2026-06-16):

1. nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning
   - pi metadata: tools=yes, reasoning=yes
   - Actual behavior: emits tool calls as JSON-in-content with </think> tag,
     NOT OpenAI tool_calls field. pi sees text, ignores intent.
   - Source: probe with 'pi --print --model nvidia/nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-omni-30b-a3b-reasoning'
     against simple "use bash to echo TOOL_OK" prompt → response is a JSON
     description of the planned bash command, never executed.

2. (Documented earlier in memory model-incompat-deepseek-v4-dsml-via-nano-gpt)
   nano-gpt/deepseek/deepseek-v4-*:thinking
   - Similar DSML-pattern failure: tool calls in custom <｜｜DSML｜｜tool_calls>
     format, nano-gpt proxy doesn't translate to OpenAI tool_calls.

3. RELATED: nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b
   - pi metadata: tools=no (correctly), reasoning=yes
   - Different failure: pi --print times out 60s+ because pi cannot parse
     NVIDIA NIM's separate `reasoning_content` delta-field in streaming.
     Direct API curl confirms model emits {"delta": {"reasoning": "...",
     "reasoning_content": "..."}} chunks BEFORE any "content" chunks; pi
     appears to wait for content, never arrives within timeout.

SUCCESS: Three concrete deliverables, any/all may land separately:

  (a) Diagnose where pi's tools=yes metadata comes from for these models
      (hardcoded list? heuristic from model name? declared by provider's
      /v1/models endpoint?). Determine if upstream pi-coding-agent should
      treat the metadata more conservatively.

  (b) Investigate if pi has (or could have) per-provider format translation
      to handle non-OpenAI tool_calls patterns (DSML, <think>+JSON,
      reasoning_content streams). If pi has a translation hook, add one for
      these known patterns. If not, file an upstream issue with pi-coding-agent.

  (c) Document the safe-profile list of "tools=yes per pi metadata but actually
      broken" models in setup-specialists v3.0 skill (epic unitAI-t86wh) so
      operators are warned at setup time.

SCRUTINY: low (research/audit task; no production diff required)

SCOPE: Read-only investigation:
  - /home/dawid/.nvm/versions/node/v24.15.0/lib/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent/dist/
    (especially core/model-resolver.js, network/openai-completions/, network/stream/)
  - https://docs.api.nvidia.com/nim/reference for NVIDIA NIM tool/reasoning format
  - https://nano-gpt.com/docs for nano-gpt proxy behavior on tool_calls
  - Verify findings with direct API probes (curl) + pi --print probes
  - Update memory keys nemotron-via-nvidia-nim-pi-incompatible + model-incompat-deepseek-v4-dsml-via-nano-gpt

NON_GOALS:
- no source code changes in this repo
- no specialist config changes
- no model assignments
- no probe automation (that's covered by epic unitAI-t86wh Phase C
  agentic-followthrough probe suite)

CONSTRAINTS:
- Operator's NVIDIA NIM key remains in ~/.pi/agent/models.json (user-supplied,
  not committed). Probes are free against NIM endpoint.
- Investigation should not write to ~/.pi/agent/models.json, only read.
- Findings get appended to existing bd memories — do not duplicate.

VALIDATION:
- A short investigation note with: source of pi metadata, concrete reproduction
  steps for each failure mode, recommended upstream issue (or PR sketch) for
  pi-coding-agent if applicable.
- Memory updated with any new findings.

OUTPUT: investigation summary (in bd notes); optional upstream issue or
discussion link; optional update to epic unitAI-t86wh Phase A skill draft.

DISCOVERED-FROM: orchestrator post-mortem of nemotron probe session 2026-06-16
REFERENCES:
  - unitAI-t86wh (epic — setup-specialists v3.0 + Phase C agentic-followthrough probe)
  - memory: nemotron-via-nvidia-nim-pi-incompatible-2026-06
  - memory: model-incompat-deepseek-v4-dsml-via-nano-gpt
  - memory: kimi-via-nano-gpt-CORRECTED-2026-06-16 (counter-example — Kimi tools work fine when thinking_level=null)
source.title: Investigate why pi 'tools: yes' metadata doesn't match agentic reality for some models
